messages:
lucas: FYI PartnerLeaf sent a dispute. They say our Azure Marketplace invoices for Mar 2026 show VAT applied at the partner level instead of per downstream customer VAT settings.

nina: Oof. Do they have examples? supplier-side VAT vs end-customer VAT can change net amounts.

lucas: Attached snippet from their invoice CSV:
```
InvoiceId,InvoiceDate,BuyerReference,DownstreamId,NetAmount,VATRate,VATAmount,GrossAmount
inv-20260301-PL,2026-03-01,partnerleaf-ms-440,pl-cust-77,1000.00,0.20,200.00,1200.00
inv-20260301-PL,2026-03-01,partnerleaf-ms-440,pl-cust-88,500.00,0.00,0.00,500.00
```
They claim pl-cust-88 is VAT-registered (should be 0% reverse-charge) while pl-cust-77 is B2C standard 20%. Our exported ledger shows VAT applied uniformly at partner account level.

cfo-ops: If our AR invoices don't match partner-provided tax treatment we risk incorrect tax filings and partner disputes. We need reconciliation and possibly corrective invoices.

partner-tax: PartnerLeaf says their mapping file includes downstream tax flags (vat_registered boolean) but our ingestion seems to have ignored that field since March 1.

nina: Where does marketplace-ingest apply VAT logic? Is it during invoice synthesis or earlier in metering ingest?

lucas: Our tax mapping runs in billing-core when we build invoice line items. It looks up downstream attributes from buyer_to_customer and tax_attributes table.

partner-tax: Here's the mapping snippet PartnerLeaf uploaded separately:
```
downstream_id,vat_registered,country
pl-cust-77,false,GB
pl-cust-88,true,DE
pl-cust-99,true,FR
```

lucas: But our buyer_to_customer join appears to have linked BuyerReference -> partner account only, not joined to their downstream mapping. So billing-core didn't see per-customer VAT flags.

cfo-ops: Immediate ask: finance needs a per-downstream reconciliation report showing net/gross/VAT differences and impacted invoice refs so we can issue corrective invoices or credit memos.

nina: I can run a query to compute delta between current invoiced VAT and expected VAT using PartnerLeaf mapping. Pseudo-query:
```
SELECT r.invoice_id, r.downstream_id, r.net_amount,
       r.vat_amount as invoiced_vat,
       CASE WHEN m.vat_registered THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(r.net_amount * 0.20,2) END as expected_vat
FROM invoices r
LEFT JOIN partnerleaf_mappings m ON r.downstream_id = m.downstream_id
WHERE r.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
AND r.seller = 'partnerleaf';
```

partner-tax: PartnerLeaf confirms mapping file timestamped 2026-03-01T02:10Z and says they supplied vat flags in the field downstream_tax_flags but our ingestion log shows missing downstream_tax_flags for their partner account on 2026-03-01 ingestion.

lucas: Engineering note: possible schema drift in partner feed; partner switched field name from downstream_tax_flags -> tax_flags during their pipeline change on 2026-02-28.

nina: I'll produce the delta CSV with columns: invoice_id, downstream_id, invoiced_vat, expected_vat, delta, action_reco. Finance can use that to prepare credit/refund items.

cfo-ops: Finance action: if expected_vat < invoiced_vat, issue credit memo to downstream and debit partner settlement for VAT overcharge. If expected_vat > invoiced_vat, partner owes tax shortfall — require partner PO to cover adjustments.

partner-tax: PartnerLeaf has approved a provisional settlement for estimated tax differences pending final reconciliation. They will also fix their field name and re-send a corrected mapping file for Feb 25-Mar 31.

azure-billing-bot: audit: ticket-7422 created, partner_mapping_partnerleaf_mar.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-7422/ at 2026-03-18T08:07:30Z :white_check_mark:

lucas: Eng follow-up: add a validation in ingestion that ensures required tax fields exist (vat_registered or tax_flags) and fail ingestion or alert when missing. Also add a nightly mismatch report for partner-level vs downstream-level VAT totals.

nina: ETA for delta CSV to finance: 4 hours. I'll attach to BILL-7422.

cfo-ops: Finance will prepare provisional credit memos using code FIN-ADJ-TAX and will not post until partner confirms final mapping. Keep thread open until reconciliation complete.

partner-tax: We'll target partner re-export by 2026-03-20 and will provide signed settlement terms for provisional adjustments.

lucas: Thanks all. Keeping BILL-7422 on the board and will update when eng validation PR merges.
